label: PRECOMPUTED
solver: STRATO BTCS five-layer spherical finite difference
note: Independent check of the BTCS release fraction against a reference that contains no BTCS code, with the observed orders in time and in space, copied from the regression suite; a regression reference, not truth.

column_headers.f_reference: Release fraction of the independent reference (dimensionless)
column_headers.abs_difference: Absolute difference of the release fractions (dimensionless)
column_headers.time_error: Estimated time-discretisation error of the BTCS run (dimensionless)
column_headers.space_error: Estimated space-discretisation error of the BTCS run (dimensionless)
column_headers.cross_error: Estimated cross term of the time and space errors (dimensionless)
column_headers.f_limit: Estimated numerical limit of the release fraction (dimensionless)
column_headers.limit_difference: Absolute difference of the reference and the estimated limit (dimensionless)
column_headers.reference_floor: Accuracy floor of the independent reference (dimensionless)
column_headers.tolerance: Convention fraction of the difference plus reference floor (dimensionless)

notes: These values were produced by the BTCS solver itself at commit ae797e6. A mismatch with a later run means that the code changed; the file is never edited by hand.
Why the values are believable: independent_check.csv beside this file compares the release fraction of this case with a reference that contains no BTCS code.
Comparison rule: |a - b| <= 1e-12 max(scale, |a|, |b|), scale = 1 for times and fractions, the initial inventory for mol, the largest concentration for mol/m^3.
reference: multilayer Sturm-Liouville eigenfunction series (analytical::sturm_liouville), 10 modes, accuracy floor 3.997129786795436e-12

check: (a) the observed orders round to 1 in time and 2 in space (|order - 1| < 0.5 and |order - 2| < 0.5); (b) |F_reference - F_limit| <= 0.05 |F_btcs - F_reference| + floor, where F_limit = F_btcs - e_time - e_space + e_cross is the limit estimated from the dt/2, dt/4, dt/8, 2n, 4n, 8n and (dt/2, 2n) refinements with the order read from the data (the cross term is added back because the time and space estimates each contain it). The 0.05 is a convention, not a derived tolerance; the orders, the uncertainties u of the estimates and the limit difference are measurements. See the module documentation of validation::regression.
separate-language anchor: F(2e5 s) = 4.325556390930383e-1 from the Python oracle pinned in tests/finite_volume_vs_analytical.rs; |series - anchor| = 4.625189120588402e-13
numerical solution of the stated model; not experimental validation
